answer: In an agent economy, mentorship lineage can anchor identity by requiring each new agent to inherit a verifiable credential chain from a seasoned mentor, much like timber must trace its growth rings to a trusted knoll. This chain is co-signed and time-locked, so a sybil cluster cannot fabricate deep history without replicating a slow glacier of accumulated attestations. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
